channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
item.description: Apple’s macOS 27 and Xcode 27 remove Intel x86_64 code from system libraries CodeQL relies on, blocking traced scans and Swift 6.4 analysis, so pin workflows to macOS 26/Xcode 26 or use build mode none for C/C++, C#, and Java. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
item.description: Anthropic’s research found technical junior roles dropping from 21% to 14% and new-hire junior share from 27% to 9%, while AI agents worked six times human hours by August 2026, and Nolan Lovett warned of a senior-talent pipeline gap.

item.title: From Carmaker to Global Smart-Tech Company: Chery's Global Innovation Conference Makes a Major Splash with the Debut of the Industry's First Sector-Specific Large Model and Humanoid Robot "Mobo
item.description: Chery used its Global Innovation Conference to announce a shift from automaker to global smart technology company and unveil two launches: the industry's first vertical-domain large model and a humanoid robot named "Mobao. (AIbase)

item.title: Exciting news: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-20261017 (Max) by @deepseek_ai is now the #1 open model in Code Arena: WebDev, surpassing Kimi K3 (Max...
item.description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-20261017 (Max) has taken the top open-model spot on Code Arena: WebDev, surpassing Kimi K3 (Max) at roughly one-tenth the cost, according to Arena.

item.title: ByteDance's Volcano Engine pours cash into incubating AI dramas, with up to 200,000 yuan per title for the monthly Top 10
item.description: ByteDance's Volcano Engine is paying up to 200,000 yuan per work to the top 10 AI-generated short dramas selected each month, spelling out the platform's concrete subsidy levels for AI drama content. (AIbase)

item.title: Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
item.description: Aachen Regional Court’s 24 September 2026 ruling, following Munich Regional Court’s late-May logic, held Google liable because its AI overview wrongly attributed another person’s sexual-assault allegation to a doctor, treating AI answers as Google’s own content.

item.title: mlabonne/llm-course — Course to get into Large Language Models (LLMs) with roadmaps and Colab notebooks.
item.description: mlabonne/llm-course splits LLM learning into three parts, covering math, Python, neural network fundamentals and SFT, and ships Colab notebooks that stay permanently free. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: Hybrid reasoning agents: LLM agents that reason in latent space and act through text
item.description: HybridAgent switches between latent-space reasoning and text-based acting within one unified generation process, and the authors report 10.4% average gains across 11 benchmarks with 35.5%–54.7% fewer tokens. (arxiv.org)

item.title: How is the employment situation at Anthropic changing?
item.description: Anthropic’s internal data and 17 interviews show its agents work six times longer than humans, junior technical hiring has slowed, and revenue per employee is 2–4 times Meta and Google’s peak, framing how AI is reshaping work. (www.anthropic.com)

item.title: Websites are shutting down their AI customer service
item.description: Yelp opens its data only to AI agents with paid licensing deals and Delta Air Lines blocks agent-assisted ticket booking, showing how sites are resisting OpenAI, Meta and Google’s agent ambitions. (www.theverge.com)
